title: mohammad taqi ki vidalat hui hai
body:
mohammad taqi ki viladat hui hai
ye shio pe haq ki inaaya hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ibne ali hai jawwaade mukarram
ataa inko haq se wilaayat hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tashreef laate hai roohe do aalam
ke jinke tasadduq me qilqat hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke bhi waaris ali ke bhi waaris
risaalat imamat wadee'at hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye masnad nashee'n hai nawe mustafa ke
tamaam inpe ismat taharat hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rajab ki thi das aur waqte seher tha
quda ki jo naazil ye rehmat hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai haq ka karam baad muddat ke poori
ali ibne moosa ki hasrat hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
inhi se hai qayam payaame mohammed
inhi se to jaari shariyat hui hai
